# Purpose
The provided content is a configuration file for a dependency update tool, likely Dependabot, which is used to automate the process of keeping dependencies up to date. The file specifies that the tool should check for updates in two package ecosystems: "maven" and "github-actions". For each ecosystem, it defines a schedule to check for updates on a monthly basis. The configuration also includes grouping rules, where all dependencies and plugins for Maven, as well as all GitHub Actions, are to be bundled into single pull requests. This setup helps streamline the update process by reducing the number of pull requests and ensuring that all related updates are handled together.
